description: This file contains instrumented UI tests for the MainActivity of an Android app, using Espresso framework to simulate user interactions and verify UI behavior related to input validation and button enabling.

classes.name: MainActivityUiTest
classes.description: A test class that defines UI tests for the MainActivity, ensuring validation messages appear for empty input and that input enables the search button.

methods.name: emptyInput_showsError
methods.description: Test that clicking search with empty input shows an error message.

methods.name: typingCity_enablesSearchButton
methods.description: Test that entering text into the city input enables the search button.
